description: BCM JSON-RPC request to fetch all software images from CMPart service

notes.authentication: Token-based cookie authentication - Cookie header automatically added by http.Client cookie jar after login
notes.login_required: Provider must first call login API: POST /json with {"service":"login","username":"root","password":"Hashicorp123!"} to obtain cm-login-token cookie
notes.cookie_management: http.Client with cookiejar.New() automatically manages Cookie header - no manual setting required
notes.tls: Endpoint uses self-signed certificate - requires insecure_skip_verify=true
notes.parameters: POV implementation does not send parameters (returns all images)
